129: export function generateShadowContent(
130:   line: Line,
131:   stage: Stage,
132:   shadowQuadrant: ShadowQuadrant | null,
133: ): ShadowEncounterContent {
134:   const quadrant = shadowQuadrant ?? 'DarkAddiction';
135:   const templates = QUADRANT_CONTENT[quadrant];
136:   const drive = driveForLine(line);
137: 
138:   // Pick narrative frame based on line (deterministic selection)
139:   const frameIndex = line.charCodeAt(0) % templates.narrativeFrames.length;
140:   const narrativeFrame = templates.narrativeFrames[frameIndex];
141: 
142:   // Fill in template variables
143:   const narrativeIntro = narrativeFrame
144:     .replace('{line}', line)
145:     .replace('{stage}', stage)
146:     .replace('{drive}', drive);
147: 
148:   // Pick prompts (use all 3 for shadow encounters — deeper engagement)
149:   const prompts = templates.prompts.map(p =>
150:     p.replace('{line}', line).replace('{stage}', stage).replace('{drive}', drive)
151:   );
152: 
153:   // Build evaluation criteria with line-specific context
154:   const evalCriteria: ShadowEvaluationCriteria = {
155:     acknowledged: `${templates.evalCriteria.acknowledged} (in the context of ${line} at ${stage})`,
156:     understood: templates.evalCriteria.understood,
157:     integrating: templates.evalCriteria.integrating,
158:     bypassing: templates.evalCriteria.bypassing,
159:   };
160: 
161:   // Fill feedback templates
162:   const integrationFeedback = templates.integrationFeedback
163:     .replace('{drive}', drive)
164:     .replace('{stage}', stage);
165: 
166:   const avoidanceFeedback = templates.avoidanceFeedback
167:     .replace('{drive}', drive)
168:     .replace('{stage}', stage);
169: 
170:   return {
171:     narrativeIntro,
172:     targetDrive: drive,
173:     prompts,
174:     evaluationCriteria: evalCriteria,
175:     integrationFeedback,
176:     avoidanceFeedback,
177:   };
